outcome: development of chronic hepatitis B infection
cohort: The study included 52 children, with 16 in the case group experiencing neonatal immunoprophylaxis failure and chronic hepatitis B infection, and 36 in the control group with successful immunoprophylaxis.
finding: Neonatal immunoprophylaxis failure risk is statistically higher if the mother is HBeAg positive and/or has a high viral load (>=2000 IU/mL).
mod_finding: Delivery methods were found to be similar between children with immunoprophylaxis failure and those with successful immunoprophylaxis, indicating no significant association.
